verdict: Maybe, for a founder close to cancer care. Eva Scalp pitched scalp cooling for chemotherapy patients on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal from three sharks. Hair loss is one of the hardest side effects of chemotherapy, and scalp cooling can reduce it, but you'll need oncologists' support and clinical evidence.
angle: Scalp cooling caps reduce hair loss during chemotherapy for some patients. Imported systems are expensive and available only in big hospitals. A cheaper device or rental model could reach more patients, but it needs clinical validation and hospital partnerships.
